claim: The colour grade half of `look`. Each preset carries both prompt tags and an ffmpeg grade; the tags are a suggestion the model often ignores, the grade is exact. Until 2026-08-03 short.py read neither and applied one hardcoded night chain to every film, which is why look appeared to do nothing.
method: ONE base keyframe with each preset's grade string applied directly, exactly as short.py make_cut() now does.
verdict: works - measured: switching a scene from the night grade to the cold grade moved its mean luma from 81.5 to 115.5 in a real render
look_at: These are the ONLY part of `look` you can rely on. Judge the grade here, and treat the tag half as a bonus. day_for_night and night share a grade on purpose.
